<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#0d1f3c; --navy2:#13294f; --ink:#1c2733; --muted:#5a6b7f;
    --gold:#c99b4a; --gold-l:#e8c98a; --blue:#2f7bff; --teal:#14a08a;
    --red:#d64545; --green:#1f9d55; --bg:#f4f6fb; --card:#ffffff;
    --line:#e3e9f2; --chip:#eef3fb;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px dashed currentColor}
  a:hover{color:var(--blue);border-bottom-color:var(--blue)}
  html,body{height:100%;background:#060b14;font-family:"Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC","Segoe UI",sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  #stage{width:1280px;height:720px;position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform-origin:center center}
  .slide{width:1280px;height:720px;position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);padding:48px 60px 66px;overflow:hidden}
  .slide.active{display:block}
  /* ---------- 通用组件 ---------- */
  .kicker{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:4px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
  h2.title{font-size:30px;color:var(--navy);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px}
  .subtitle{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:22px}
  .tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;vertical-align:middle}
  .tag.ok{background:#e2f6ea;color:var(--green)} .tag.info{background:#e7efff;color:var(--blue)}
  .tag.gold{background:#faf0dc;color:#9a7128} .tag.red{background:#fdeaea;color:var(--red)}
  .grid{display:grid;gap:14px}
  .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(16,32,64,.05)}
  .card h4{font-size:15px;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:6px}
  .card p,.card li{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75}
  .card .num{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold)}
  table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--card);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;font-size:12.5px}
  th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:8px 10px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
  td{padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6;vertical-align:top}
  tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#fafbfe}
  .flow{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;flex-wrap:nowrap}
  .fbox{background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;text-align:center;flex:1;min-width:0}
  .fbox b{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:3px}
  .fbox.hl{border-color:var(--gold);background:#fffaf0}
  .fbox.blue{border-color:var(--blue);background:#f0f6ff}
  .fbox.green{border-color:var(--green);background:#f0faf4}
  .fbox.red{border-color:var(--red);background:#fdf3f3}
  .arrow{align-self:center;color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;padding:0 6px;flex:none}
  .down{ text-align:center;color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;font-size:18px;margin:6px 0}
  .pill{display:inline-block;background:var(--chip);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:11.5px;margin:2px 3px 2px 0;color:var(--navy)}
  .code{font-family:Consolas,"Courier New",monospace;background:#0f2038;color:#d7e3f4;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;white-space:pre-wrap}
  .code .g{color:#7ee2a8}.code .y{color:#f0c96e}.code .c{color:#7d93ad}
  .foot{position:absolute;left:60px;right:60px;bottom:18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:#9aa8ba}
  .badge-v{position:absolute;top:44px;right:60px}
  /* ---------- 封面 ---------- */
  .cover{background:radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 78% 18%,#1d3a6d 0%,var(--navy) 45%,#081226 100%);color:#fff}
  .slide.active.cover{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
  .cover .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:26px}
  .cover .mark{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),#8a6420);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(201,155,74,.35)}
  .cover h1{font-size:52px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;line-height:1.25}
  .cover h1 span{color:var(--gold-l)}
  .cover .sub{font-size:19px;color:#b9c8de;margin-top:14px;letter-spacing:1px}
  .cover .loop{margin-top:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .cover .loop .step{border:1px solid rgba(232,201,138,.5);color:var(--gold-l);border-radius:24px;padding:7px 18px;font-size:14px;background:rgba(20,41,79,.55)}
  .cover .loop .a{color:var(--gold-l);font-size:16px}
  .cover .meta{margin-top:44px;font-size:13px;color:#8fa2bd;line-height:2}
  /* ---------- 导航 ---------- */
  #nav{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:14px;display:flex;gap:8px;z-index:50}
  #nav button{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:rgba(13,31,60,.85);color:#fff;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}
  #counter{position:fixed;left:18px;bottom:18px;color:#8fa2bd;font-size:12px;z-index:50;background:rgba(13,31,60,.6);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px}
  #bar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--blue));z-index:60;transition:width .25s}
  @media print{
    html,body{background:#fff;overflow:visible}
    #stage{position:static;transform:none!important;width:auto;height:auto}
    .slide{display:block!important;page-break-after:always;position:relative;margin:0 auto}
    #nav,#counter,#bar{display:none}
  }
</style>
script:
<script>
const slides=[...document.querySelectorAll('.slide')];
let cur=0;
function show(i){
  cur=(i+slides.length)%slides.length;
  slides.forEach((s,j)=>s.classList.toggle('active',j===cur));
  document.getElementById('counter').textContent=(cur+1)+' / '+slides.length;
  document.getElementById('bar').style.width=((cur+1)/slides.length*100)+'%';
}
function go(d){show(cur+d)}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(['ArrowRight','ArrowDown','PageDown',' '].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();go(1)}
  else if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowUp','PageUp'].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();go(-1)}
  else if(e.key==='Home')show(0);
  else if(e.key==='End')show(slides.length-1);
  else if(e.key==='f'||e.key==='F')toggleFs();
});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(e.target.closest('#nav')||e.target.closest('button'))return;
  go(e.clientX>window.innerWidth*0.5?1:-1);
});
function toggleFs(){
  if(!document.fullscreenElement)document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
  else document.exitFullscreen();
}
function fit(){
  const s=Math.min(innerWidth/1280,innerHeight/720);
  const st=document.getElementById('stage');
  st.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale('+s+')';
}
addEventListener('resize',fit);fit();show(0);
</script>
